name: incident.io
what: Incident-management platform (on-call, Slack/Teams-based response, status pages, post-mortems) with AI agents that investigate and help resolve outages.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026) and on the archived visionaries.vc/portfolio page from the 2024-04-24 capture onward (absent from the 2023-06-01 capture). No press or company source names Visionaries in any incident.io round.

valuation.quote: sources close to the deal tell me it's in the region of $400 million

notes: Entry undetermined: Visionaries is named in none of the round reports (seed and Series A: TechCrunch 2022-07-13, SiliconANGLE 2022-07-13; Series B: company release on PR Newswire 2025-04-10 names only Insight, Index and Point Nine; TechCrunch 2025-04-10 the same). The firm's site added incident.io between the 2023-06-01 and 2024-04-24 archive captures, a window with no announced primary round, so the position may be a secondary purchase or an unannounced extension; if the judge needs a stage, it is after the July 2022 Series A (Growth-stage), not seed. WebSearch 'incident.io "Visionaries Club" investment' returned only vendor profiles. Valuation: the company did not disclose it; TechCrunch reports ~$400M from sources, the figure the Point Nine and Insight siblings cite (they left valuation_usd blank); TechCrunch also says ~$300M about three years earlier. No round after April 2025 found (googlenews '"incident.io" raises'). Founded 2021 per the company's release ('Founded in 2021'). HQ London with San Francisco office; agrees with both siblings.
